stories.title: South Carolina company recalls biscuit sandwiches over listeria risk
stories.summary: The Longs company said the sandwiches went to convenience stores, vending machines and prison canteens in the Carolinas and Virginia for over eight months.

stories.title: Chappelle Memorial A.M.E. Church carries on Edith General's free Thanksgiving dinner in Columbia
stories.summary: Edith General set out to feed people in need after meeting a hungry young man. More than 30 years later, her church's Thanksgiving dinner carries on.

stories.title: Coroner names 3 women in Elloree boarding home fire that investigators say was intentionally set
stories.summary: All three died of smoke inhalation, the coroner said. A 74-year-old resident is charged with first-degree arson.

stories.title: SC flu hospitalizations near 1,000, almost triple the usual pace for this point in the season
stories.summary: South Carolina reported 245 flu hospitalizations and two deaths the week before Thanksgiving. More than half of patients are 65 and older.

stories.title: Aiken Electric restores power after substation problem causes Thanksgiving outage
stories.summary: A bad lightning arrester at a substation knocked out power in Aiken Electric Cooperative's North district on Thanksgiving. Power is back on.

stories.title: Three people hurt in Lee County house fire on Tomarla Drive, firefighters say
stories.summary: Three people escaped a house fire on Tomarla Drive but were hurt and taken to a hospital, the Lee County Fire Department said. The cause is under investigation.

stories.title: Irmo dancers stay in New York after weather pushes Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday
stories.summary: Dancers from Irmo's Dance Department changed flights and hotel plans to stay in New York for the 100th Macy's parade, now set for Saturday.

stories.title: Unattended grill sparks Thanksgiving duplex fire in Columbia, displacing two families
stories.summary: Firefighters said a grill left unattended on a second-story balcony started the fire on Battery Walk Court. Five adults, a child and four pets were displaced.

stories.title: Turkey Day 5K draws more than 1,700 runners in Columbia on Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Runners in turkey and side-dish costumes, kids running for their grandma and a dog named Waffles hit the course to support Boys & Girls Clubs of the Midlands.

stories.title: Crash blocks Sumter Highway at Boykin Road in Camden, Kershaw County Fire Service says
stories.summary: Kershaw County firefighters and EMS are working a crash at Sumter Highway and Boykin Road in Camden. The road is blocked, and drivers should use caution.

stories.title: Grease blamed for 1,328-gallon sewer overflow on Garners Ferry Road, state report shows
stories.summary: A City of Columbia sewer overflow tied to grease sent 1,328 gallons from a manhole into a storm drain, a state environmental report shows.

stories.title: SC man charged with murder in wife's 2020 disappearance after arrest in Georgia, deputies say
stories.summary: Charleston County deputies say Harry Capers III, 42, was arrested in Georgia and extradited Monday. He's charged with murder in his wife's 2020 death.
